description: This file provides functions to parse INI configuration files into a Config object, including type coercion and nested value setting, for the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: configFromIniFile
methods.description: Reads an INI file and converts it into a Config object.

methods.name: configsFromIniFile
methods.description: Reads an INI file with multiple sections and returns a map of section names to Config objects.

methods.name: iniEntriesToConfig
methods.description: Converts INI entries into a Config object with proper typing and nested structure.

methods.name: coerceToType
methods.description: Converts raw values to specified types such as string, number, boolean, string[], or size.

methods.name: coerceIniValue
methods.description: Converts string INI values to appropriate types like number or leaves as string.

methods.name: setNestedValue
methods.description: Sets a value in an object at a nested path specified by dot notation.
